last_analysis: No scores are visible, so I can only reason about the design. Every trial trained without errors, so the time limit and compute cap are not binding at these sizes. Over three rounds the search explored two kinds of change. On the recipe side it tried fewer PPO epochs with more fresh samples, and a longer horizon (gamma 0.99, lambda 0.95) to carry the exact-build bonus back to early placements. On the architecture side it tried per-layer heads (logsumexp, then a landing-gated version), layer attention, and a deeper dilated trunk with global context. The strongest recipe idea, 1 epoch with 512 envs at long horizon, has only been tested on the starting network. The structural heads have only used 2 epochs with about 135k samples. Since this is the last round and the final pick goes to the best 2-seed score, the best bets pair the most promising structures with the data-heavy recipe, plus one low-risk recipe refinement on the starting network.
